notes.title: Patchnote #54 for Dark Hours (v0.10.21622)
notes.content:
[h2]Patchnote #54 for Dark Hours (v0.10.21622) - 03/09/2025[/h2]
[h3]Monster[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Monster Double Door Animation Modified[/b]: Updated the animation for monsters passing through double doors.
[*][b]Driftborn Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where the Driftborn could very rarely spawn on a player and catch them instantly.
[*][b]Driftborn SFX Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where the Driftborn’s sound effects were not played correctly.
[*][b]Trickster’s Dance Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug causing the Trickster’s dance countdown to occasionally be misaligned.
[*][b]Cursed Pharaoh Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the player would spin continuously when cursed and caught by the Cursed Pharaoh.
[*][b]Stone Stalkers & Gate Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where Stone Stalkers could pass through gates while they were opening.
[*][b]Stone Stalkers & Double Door Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where a statue could get stuck when passing through a double door specifically in the museum.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Blinking Laser Puzzle Modified[/b]: Slowed down the laser sweep from Medium to Nightmare difficulty.
[/list]
[h3]LD[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Lighting Optimization[/b]: Optimized lighting to significantly improve performance, particularly on the Cruise Ship environment.
[*][b]Preset Collision Fix[/b]: Removed collision presets from certain environment assets to prevent players from getting stuck on them.
[*][b]Furniture Position Changes[/b]: Modified some furniture positions to avoid issues with monster navigation.
[*][b]Restoration Room Museum Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where ceiling lights only partially spawned on certain seeds.
[*][b]Cruise Ship Piano Stool Modified[/b]: Modified the piano stool to be a physics-based object.
[*][b]Kitchen Table Fix[/b]: Fixed the kitchen table collider to make hiding under tables easier.
[*][b]Bathroom Sink Outline Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the towel next to the sink was also outlined.
[*][b]Glass Archives Fix[/b]: Fixed a glass pane in the museum that was too transparent.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Lobby UI Adjusted[/b]: Adjustments made to the lobby UI.
[*][b]Gate Opening Animation Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that allowed players to open gates from too far away.
[*][b]Help to Climb Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the assist climb animation could trigger from a distance.
[*][b]Camera system Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where rooms observed by the camera system were sometimes not lit.
[*][b]Player Name & Rejoin Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where, if a player died while another was rejoining, the rejoining player could not see the dead player’s name.
[*][b]Dead Player Info Fix[/b]: When a player disconnects, they are now marked as “Disconnected” in the team info panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnote #53 for Dark Hours (v0.10.21532)
notes.content:

[h3]Monster[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Navigation Monster Improvement[/b]: Improved monster navigation system to improve performance.

[list]
[*][b]Timer Bomb Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the bomb objective timer showed an incorrect value at the start.
[*][b]Dartgun Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where players were sometimes not put to sleep after being hit by a dart gun shot.
[*][b]Dartgun Kill Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue allowing players to be killed by two dart gun shots.
[*][b]Noise-Cancelling Headset Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where other players could not see the headset when the host equipped it.
[/list]
[h3]LD[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Explosive Location Clue Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where the location clue was not displayed for the locker in the Museum locker room.
[*][b]Collider Ceiling Light Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where Cruise ship basement light colliders blocked player movement on the upper floor.
[*][b]Spawner Position on Casino Fix[/b]: Fixed the stone bench spawner position in the Casino.
[*][b]Power Plant Break Room Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the break room sometimes had no lighting.
[*][b]Trashcan on Cruise Ship Fix[/b]: Fixed trashcans spawning in narrow corridors and blocking player navigation.

[list]
[*][b]Washing Machine Fix[/b]: The interaction sound with the washing machine is now properly spatialized.
[*][b]Rubber chicken Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the rubber chicken sound was not played at the correct position.
[*][b]Lightswitch Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where some lightswitches were not generated.

[list]
[*][b]Lighting Improvement[/b]: Changes have been applied to the lighting to improve in-game performance on the Cruise Ship map.
[*][b]Rejoin Player Name Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where a player rejoining a match could no longer see the names of players who had died in the meantime.
[*][b]Client Custom Color Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where client customization changes were sometimes not applied.
[*][b]Bad Customization Color Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the wrong color was sometimes applied to customization.
[*][b]Death in Lobby Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue that allowed players to die in the lobby.

[*]Stone Stalker: We are aware of a bug where Stone Stalkers can pass through gates before they are fully opened. This will be fixed as soon as possible.

notes.title: What's next & updated Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/9b711198d192ca957e9425739081ad3904c8620e.png[/img]

[h2]Hey everyone,[/h2]

Hope you're all doing great!

Today, we're sharing some (not-so-little) news along with an updated roadmap. But before diving into the future, we thought it would be cool to take a step back and look at everything that's been done in Dark Hours. It's already been 5 months since the launch in Early Access!

Here's the breakdown of this news so you can jump straight to what interests you most:
[list]
[*] 1. Key statistics from the past 5 months
[*] 2. All new features added since launch
[*] 3. Community-requested features
[*] 4. What's coming in the next  few months: Roadmap update & more
[/list]
We already have a lot of ideas and new features planned for the future of Dark Hours. Let us share our scheduled plan with you. Our goal is to gather your feedback as we may adapt this plan based on your inputs.


[h3]1. Key Statistics[/h3]
Since Early Access of October 2024, we've already released 3 major updates and 33 patches in total. Over 350,000 players have joined us on this journey. It's just... wow... insane!

During the first weekend of March, we even hit our highest peak of concurrent players, with more than 1,800 players online at the same time. That's incredible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/8e056628b52f4fc2053ad8f7eafe6a5d54addf78.png[/img]

[h3]2. All new features added since launch[/h3]
To better review everything that has been done, we’re listing below all the additions since launch in bullet points. It’s a great way to see how far we’ve come before diving into what’s next!

[list]
[*] 3 New Monsters
[*] 2 New Environments
[*] 6 New Gameplay Items
[*] 1 New Game Mode: Golden Tag
[*] 3 Difficulty Settings
[*] Spray Tags with 4 tags to help navigate in the maps
[*] 14 Emotes (Ranging from gameplay communication to social emotes)
[*] 3 Dances (because dancing while your teammate gets grabbed by a monster is always funny)
[*] 2 Seasonal Customization Sets
[*] 1 New Playable Character
[*] 5 Customizable Backpacks
[*] 2 new Mini-Games and 1 vault puzzle
[*] A brand-new 3D Lobby
[*] 5 new localizations: Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and Finnish (for 24 in total)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/79234faba14092675a0cf9a9837d5e8ea8aacb55.png[/img]

[h3]3. Community-requested features[/h3]
You've given us tons of great suggestions to make Dark Hours even better. We've done our best to implement some of your requests and address your needs. 

Here’s a list of features that were added based on your feedback:
[list] 
[*] Ability to [b]ban multiple monsters[/b]
[*] Ability to [b]kick & ban players from your lobby[/b]
[*] Leave your marks to help you find your way more easily: [b]the Spray Tags[/b]
[*] A way to revive dead players: [b]the Defibrillator[/b]
[*] [b]Highlighting key objects[/b] in the levels (sparkles/items glint)
[*] [b]Key rebinding[/b]
[*] [b]Push to Talk[/b] option for voice chat
[*] Option to [b]disable camera shaking[/b]
[*] Option to [b]hide the UI[/b]
[*] [b]Quickplay mode[/b] to find other players more easily (will still be improved)
[*] [b]Network improvements[/b] (will also still be improved!)
[/list]

And yet, we still have a long list of community-inspired features that we’re planning to add in the future:
[list]
[*] [b]Facing multiple monsters[/b] at the same time
[*] [b]Monster Codex[/b] for better understanding creatures
[*] Increasing the [b]player limit beyond 4 players[/b]
[*] [b]Personal objectives[/b]
[*] [b]Advanced Items[/b]
[*] [b]Ghost cam improvement[/b] for better interaction of dead players with the environment
[*] Maps with [b]multiple floors[/b]
[*] [b]Minimap[/b]
[*] [b]Final score & medal system rework[/b]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b] (Planned for the full 1.0 release)
[*] [b]Placing fuses more easily[/b], without having to manually take them out of your bag
[*] [b]Switching items using hotkeys[/b]
[/list]
Other highly requested features, like [b]rejoining a match[/b], [b]text chat[/b], [b]shop system improvements[/b], and a [b]FOV slider[/b] need more particular design and technical work, but we are working on it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/a615868d8058dda8bf94174aa524a770d59fbf86.png[/img]

[h3]4. What's Coming Next?[/h3]
In addition to the list above, we also have plans to enrich the game with some exciting new features & improvements.

[list]
[*] [b]New Maps[/b]: Since you've made it this far, we're revealing the next map of Dark Hours: the Nuclear Power Plant! More maps will follow but we’ll keep it for a next devlog if you will! 
[*] [b]New Monsters[/b]: And our next challenger will be the Electric Poltergeist! Stay tuned for more! 
[*] [b]Monster Variants[/b]: We’ll let you guess what this could mean!
[*] The arrival of the [b]Nightmare Mode[/b] in difficulty settings!!! 
[*] New [b]Contracts[/b], [b]Objectives[/b] and [b]Mini-Games[/b]
[*] [b]PVP Game Mode[/b]
[*] [b]Community Features[/b]: This might sound a bit vague, but we’d love to introduce the idea that you’re not the only team of thieves in the game. So, expect features like leaderboards, an in-game friends list, and shared data like the number of heists happening at the same time and so on...
[*][b] Progression System[/b]: We also want to introduce a progression system, but the design is still being explored. I won’t say more!
[*] [b]Seasonal Events[/b]: We’ve already had two seasonal events with some cool customizations. But we’re excited to make them even better by adding in-game decorations and themed loot (for instance, a chocolate bunny for Easter—just throwing that idea out there!).
[*] We already have some ideas to further [b]enrich the customization features[/b] currently available, and we thought it would be great to [b]let you customize your team bag[/b] as well!
[*] [b]Expanding the Game's Lore[/b]: We’d like to develop the concept of the Mafia Boss, where he wouldn’t be the only one giving you missions but would be in competition with other bosses.
[/list]

We’ve also got [b]some features[/b] already in the game that [b]we want to improve[/b], and we'll keep working on them! These are long-term tasks that will be addressed in future updates.
[list]
[*] [b]Rework of the game loop [/b]: To start, we are exploring ways to allow players to return to the level if they leave in the van. We might also make a few other changes to the game loop, gameplay items, and shops.
[*] [b]Monsters Balancing and Improvements:[/b] there’s still room for improvement, whether it’s balancing them, clarifying some mechanics or fixing some remaining bugs.
[*] [b]Kisser Rework[/b] as we want them back in the game.
[*] [b]Difficulty modes balancing follow-up[/b] at each regular and major updates.
[*] [b]Loot improvement:[/b] either regarding loot placement, repetitions in the same room, and values regarding your progression in the maps.
[*] [b]Improvement of Procedural Map Generation:[/b] we will add more verticality to the levels with multiple floors. We are also working to be able to add more freedom in the discovery of new maps seeds, and more variation in map sizes.
[*] [b]Network Improvements:[/b] there’s still work to be done on network performance, particularly with physics, latency, and disconnections! We’re on it!
[*] [b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] It's a long-term effort that we've already started and will continue with each patch release. Our goal is to improve Dark Hours so that as many players as possible can enjoy it, no matter their setup.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/87ba2c95ef05c6b1f1b35194528f44e50e935ee0.png[/img]


[h3]Roadmap[/h3]

We've also taken the opportunity to update the roadmap for the upcoming major updates. Feel free to check it out; it’s also available on the Steam page if needed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/ab0e2cce05cb812a57eefcdad19b27524474dde2.png[/img]

We're really excited about everything we've shared and hope you are too! 
Do not hesitate to leave a comment under this news, email us at [b]contact@darkhours-thegame.com[/b], or come chat with us directly on [url=https://discord.gg/pieceofcake]Discord[/url]. Feel free to let us know what you think about all the new features announced? Are you hype? Have we missed anything? Let us know!

We are thinking to make more news like this one, to talk to you more about the developpement. Is it something that you want? If so, don't hesitate to tell us! We're curious about it!

Thank you all for taking the time to read this far! 

Piece of Cake Team

notes.title: The Cursed Pharaoh Major Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that [b]The Cursed Pharaoh Update[/b] for Dark Hours is [b]now available[/b] for everyone!
This major update brings plenty of new content, including planned features, highly requested features from the community, and a few surprises!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/99bab9e35ea4b9a2f9a4d1d270ec26429f1b12f8.png[/img]

[h1]What you’ve been waiting for[/h1]

[h2] 🔪 An ancient slasher comes to hunt you: The Mummy[/h2]
Get ready to be chased by a brand-new creature: the Mummy. This terrifying monster loves watching you and slowly closing in to impale you with its blade!

[h2]🏛 Want to pull off a heist in a [b]Museum[/b], right? Let's go! [/h2]
What better place than a [b]Museum[/b] to line your pockets? A brand-new heist environment, [b]The Museum[/b], is now available to explore. Enjoy a set of 16 different layouts to make each of your heists unique! Time to plan your next big score!

[previewyoutube=FlmpukPv6IA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]But also[/h1]

[h2]👋Say hello to the newest member of the team[/h2]
The boss wanted to strengthen our crew. So he brought in this new recruit. Consider them one of us! You now have the choice between two types of burglars!

[h2]🤝Quickplay feature[/h2]
Assemble a team of professional burglars faster than the speed of light! By popular demand, we’ve added a quick matchmaking system to make it easier to form groups.
[u]Note[/u]: The servers will be active starting tomorrow.

[h2]🎒Stay stylish while you steal![/h2]
Wanted to switch up your backpack? This update is for you! You can now customize your backpacks!

[h2]🧯Discover new playable items![/h2]
While we already had a hairdryer and a foghorn, what else could we possibly add to the game? Well, it’s simple:
[list]
[*] [b]Coffee:[/b] Grab a cup, place it in the coffee machine, and enjoy a nice hot brew!
[*] [b]Extinguisher:[/b] What could you possibly do with this during a heist? I’ll let you figure that out!
[*] [b]Defibrillator:[/b] You can now revive a teammate who died too soon. Just be careful—it’s charged with electricity, so don’t shock someone who’s still alive!
[/list]
[h2]🙋‍♀️Allo? Allo??[/h2]
You wanted a way to communicate in the game without micro, and now it’s here! Check out our brand-new tag feature and fresh emotes. 

[h2]🏃🏿‍♂️ Golden Tag game mode?[/h2]
But what's the "[b]Golden Tag[/b]"? We wanted to introduce a lighter, more fun game mode to play between heists! Your goal is to keep the title for as long as possible! Your opponents can take it from you by pushing you.[b] Anything goes.[/b]

[h2]🎮Some Improvements[/h2]
We’ve improved the keybinding interface to make it smoother and more user-friendly! To prevent you from getting completely stuck when choosing contracts, we’ve also added a countdown! Other minor improvements have also been made based on your feedback!


[h1]🎇And what's next?[/h1]
This update will be the last major one for 2024, but it’s definitely not the last we have planned for Dark Hours!. Starting in 2025. more updates are planned so get ready for more features to come! 

As always, we can’t wait to hear your feedback. Feel free to share it on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2208570/discussions/]Steam forums[/url], on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]Discord[/url], or directly via email. 

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed designing and developing it! We can't wait to hear all about how your heists went!

We’re thrilled to announce the arrival of our very first major update since Early Access launched! This update is packed with fresh new content and improvements inspired by your feedback. Here’s a breakdown of everything new: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/23132d23a329b80bd73a04ea76bb085cb7d1aff7.png[/img]

All these changes aim to improve the overall gameplay experience. You can find the complete patchnote just below. 


[h2]✨ And what's next? [/h2]
We’re deeply grateful for all the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared with us since the launch. The team is actively working on the next big update planned for the holiday season, and we’re excited to tease the arrival of a brand-new map environment (yes, we heard you 😉) with dozens of layouts, along with new contract objectives, a new monster and even more surprises.

notes.title: When is the Early Access release of Dark Hours?
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First off, I want to thank you all for the amazing support and excitement you show for Dark Hours. We’re so happy to have such a passionate community by our side. 

Now, let’s talk about what you’ve all been waiting for! 
[h3][b]When is the Early Access release?[/b][/h3]


We know we’ve been quiet lately, and many of you have been asking about the Early Access release date. Today, I’d like to share some insights on the development of Dark Hours over the past few months. 

When we began working on Dark Hours, all we wanted was to create a fun co-op horror game to enjoy with friends, and we didn’t expect such an amazing reaction from you all. The enthusiasm you’ve shown for the game has been incredible — more than 2 millions downloads for the demo and the prologue as I’m writing these lines… mind-blowing! — and your excitement to see more is beyond what we ever dreamed of.

With so many players on board, we definitely feel the pressure now. As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility, and we’re aware of the high expectations for the Early Access release. Gosh, this is challenging, but we’re dedicated to meeting those expectations and offering you a truly unique and fun co-op heist-horror experience that lives up to your excitement.


That’s why we’ve taken the time to read all your messages, comments and feedback, and to respond as much as we can on the Steam forums and our Discord (and yes, it takes time!). We’re also actively working on many new features that we want to have ready for Early Access, including:
[list]
[*] New scary monsters
[*] Difficulty levels from Easy to Nightmare
[*] Customization options like colors and items
[*] Procedurally generated maps - which is not so easy to implement 😅
[*] An improved gameplay loop to immerse you even more into your heist night
[*] New missions other than stealing the Royal Crown
[*] New gameplay items, and fun gameplay features
[*] … and other cool stuff I might have missed!
[/list] All this to ensure we can bring you the best possible experience for you and your friends.


[h3]So, we’ve decided to reschedule the Early Access launch to the end of October.[/h3]

This extra time will allow us to add and polish all these exciting new features you’ve been asking for.
We know the wait is going to be a bit longer than expected, please bear with us!

[*] New: “Knock knock” animation when the player is crouching or crawling
[*] New: Add Safes.

[list]
[*] Behavior Enhancements: Various improvements to the monster's behavior and animations.
[*] Capture Timing: Fixed issues with the monster's capture timing and interaction with lights.
[*] Speed Increase: The monster now accelerates after two seconds of pursuit but loses target memory faster to encourage evasive maneuvers.
[*] Action Delay: Reduced the maximum delay between two actions of the monster from 0.5 seconds to 0 seconds.
[*] ADD: Monster doorway passage animation
[/list]
[b] Interface: [/b]
[list]
[*] VFX: Updated VFX for small lights
[*] UI Enhancements: Add new layouts for “dying” and “reviving” overlays

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/b87ad6fa43ecae2252c71ccd21bb3d5b21a0342c.png[/img]
